v.id AS id, v.vendor_code AS vendorCode, v.name AS vendorName, v.work_telephone AS officeTelephone, v.contact_telephone AS otherTelephone, v.address AS address, v.other_number AS otherNumber, v.country_id AS countryId, countries.name AS countryName, v.fax_number AS faxNumber, v.vat_id AS vatId, vat_settings.name AS vatName, v.payment_term_id AS paymentTermId, payment_terms.name AS paymentTermName, v.email_address AS emailAddress, v.created AS created, CONCAT(users1.first_name, ' ', users1.last_name) AS createdBy, v.modified AS modified, CONCAT(users2.first_name, ' ', users2.last_name) AS modifiedBy

FROM vendors v LEFT JOIN users AS users1 ON users1.id = v.created_by LEFT JOIN users AS users2 ON users2.id = v.modified_by LEFT JOIN countries ON countries.id = v.country_id LEFT JOIN payment_terms ON payment_terms.id = v.payment_term_id LEFT JOIN vat_settings ON vat_settings.id = v.vat_id

SELECT gl.id AS generalLedgerId, gl.date AS `date`, SUM(gld.debit) AS debit, SUM(gld.credit) AS credit, gld.chart_account_id AS chartAccountId, gld.company_id AS companyId, gld.location_id AS locationId, gld.customer_id AS customerId, gld.vendor_id AS vendorId, gld.employee_id AS employeeId FROM general_ledgers gl INNER JOIN general_ledger_details gld ON gl.id=gld.general_ledger_id WHERE gl.is_approve = 1 AND gl.is_active = 1
AND gl.date >= DATE(#{filter.dateFrom})
AND gl.date <= DATE(#{filter.dateTo})
AND chart_account_id IN ( SELECT id FROM chart_accounts WHERE is_active=1 AND chart_account_type_id IN (SELECT id FROM chart_account_types WHERE name='Accounts Payable') ) AND company_id IN ( SELECT company_id FROM user_companies WHERE user_id = #{userId} ) AND vendor_id IS NOT NULL AND vendor_id !='' GROUP BY chart_account_id,company_id,location_id,customer_id,vendor_id,employee_id
